title: Sections of a quasi-coherent module on nested affine opens satisfy tensor base change
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme and $\mathcal M$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_S$-module. For affine opens $U\subseteq U'$ of $S$, put $R=\mathcal O_S(U)$, $R'=\mathcal O_S(U')$, $M=\mathcal M(U)$ and $M'=\mathcal M(U')$. Then the canonical $R$-linear map $M'\otimes_{R'}R\to M$, $m'\otimes r\mapsto r\,m'|_U$, is an isomorphism.

source.place: Constructions, Lemma 01LN (lemma-spec-inclusion), using Schemes Lemmas 01I9 and 01IA

proof.text: Apply exists_tensorPullback_affine_sections to f = id_X and the nested affine opens V and U. Its algebra map id_X.appLE is definitionally the restriction O(V) -> O(U). Obtain c with bijectivity, scalar compatibility, and the unit pure-tensor formula.

Let adj be the canonical tensor pullback adjunction for id_X. Transport its right adjoint along pushforwardId X, and compare the resulting left adjoint with the identity adjunction using leftAdjointUniq. This gives k : tensorPullback(id_X) ~= id. The Mathlib unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app equation, evaluated on sections, proves k(eta(s)) = s.

On U, k is a bijective O(U)-linear section map d, also O(V)-linear by restriction of scalars. Take d composed with c. Bijectivity follows by composition, and O(U)-scalar compatibility follows from the corresponding property of c and module morphism linearity. Naturality of k with respect to U <= V followed by k(eta(m)) = m proves the canonical formula d(c(m tensor r)) = r times m restricted to U.
